dependencies.name: Playwright
dependencies.description: Locked web discovery engine for JS rendering, infinite scroll, pagination, and category traversal across vendor sites.

dependencies.name: Background Job Queue
dependencies.description: Queue required for scraping and AI processing jobs; per-category parallel jobs that retry or resume independently.

dependencies.name: AI Provider Adapter Implementations
dependencies.description: At least one adapter (e.g., OpenAI-compatible) needed for AI features; graceful degradation when zero configured.
evidence_refs: System-References/PRD Docs/Inference Layer summary.md#AI Provider Adapter Pattern

dependencies.name: OCR Engine
dependencies.description: OCR for scanned vendor PDFs before AI extraction.
evidence_refs: System-References/PRD Docs/Source Blender PRD.md#PDF Catalog Import

dependencies.name: Object Storage
dependencies.description: Storage for uploaded PDFs, cached rendered DOM, and generated export artifacts (PDFs/PNGs).

dependencies.name: Database
dependencies.description: Persistence for workspaces, vendors, catalog, discovery sessions, vendor and document memory timelines, pricing, collections, and analytics.

dependencies.name: Authentication
dependencies.description: Workspace-level authentication so catalog data is workspace-scoped.

dependencies.name: Multi-tenancy Layer
dependencies.description: Tenant isolation across workspaces for catalog, AI provider credentials, and storage.

dependencies.name: Validation Engine
dependencies.description: Deterministic validation of AI and import outputs: missing fields, duplicates, SKU, price, category, business rules, inventory conflicts.

dependencies.name: Capability Router
dependencies.description: Routes AI requests by capability to a configured provider.

dependencies.name: Ingestion / Normalization Engine
dependencies.description: Parses, normalizes, cleans, and transforms raw imports into Source BlendR normalized JSON before AI enrichment.

dependencies.name: PDF Generation Library
dependencies.description: Library for generating PDF and PNG exports for flyers and quotes.

dependencies.name: Search Index
dependencies.description: Index for global search, vendor/category/item-type filters, tags, and favorites across catalog and discovery.

dependency_relationships.relationship: Playwright scraping jobs must run on the background queue.
Scraped raw output is normalized by the ingestion engine.
Normalized JSON feeds into AI enrichment via adapters; degrades gracefully if no providers.
AI requests routed by capability router.
PDF OCR passes content through AI extraction.
Search index is built from catalog data.

architecture_sensitive_dependencies.note: Background queue semantics and retry model affect scraping job throughput and UI responsiveness.
Single Universal Catalog Item schema shapes the entire persistence and validation architecture.
Multi-tenancy enforcement percolates across database schema, storage, search index, and AI provider credential isolation.
Normalization contract is the boundary every future connector must satisfy.
Validation engine contract is the gate between AI output and inventory.
Capability router contract must remain stable across provider swaps.

stage_decision_brief.recommended_direction: Build Source BlendR as an AI-agnostic Vendor Intelligence Platform: multi-tenant workspaces, Playwright-first website discovery, PDF catalog extraction, Discovery Session staging before import, Universal Catalog Items (products, services, rentals, labor, manufacturing, installation), AI Provider Adapter Architecture with capability routing, background workers, and deferred future features per the PRD.
alternatives_considered: Single AI provider only (rejected: violates AI-agnostic locked principle)
Auto-import without Discovery Sessions (rejected: violates discovery-before-import locked principle)
Product-only catalog (rejected: violates Universal Catalog Items locked decision)
Plug-in marketplace architecture (rejected: explicitly out of scope in Inference Layer summary)
key_decisions: Playwright is the locked web discovery engine
AI is provider-agnostic via adapter architecture and capability router
Discovery Sessions always gate catalog imports
Universal Catalog Items replace Product-only schema
Manual entry is a first-class workflow; platform runs with zero AI providers
Background workers handle scraping and AI processing
PDF imports are equal in status to website imports
Flyer and Quote Builders are should-have; may be trimmed or deferred to protect MVP risk

assumptions.assumption: Playwright + AI-assisted site analysis handles the majority of target-market vendor sites.
Target users value provider independence and owned catalog data.
Discovery Sessions are accepted as friction-positive vs auto-import competitors.
Universal Catalog Items cover the target market without forcing partial re-architecture.
Background workers keep the UI responsive for expected scrape/AI durations without a streaming UI.

risks.description: Playwright reliability across diverse vendor sites
Target market too small or unwilling to pay

downstream_impact: Stage 2 must validate differentiation hypotheses, market demand, and technical assumptions (Playwright reliability, OCR/AI extraction quality, Universal Catalog schema coverage).
Stage 3 must lock adapter interface, capability router contract, validation engine contract, multi-tenancy isolation boundary, and queue/timeout strategy.
Stage 4 must validate Discovery Session UX and catalog browsing UX.
Stage 5 slices import-to-catalog flow, adapter architecture, and catalog as launch-critical; flyer/quote as should-have.
Stage 6 acceptance criteria must include AI extraction-quality tests per capability and validation engine tests.
